GAUGE HISTORY		
----------------------		  
2018: Drift of TG0 over 15-16 January; sharp offset of ~0.08m between 15:15 and 15:25 on 21 January.
2019: TG0 raised 0.122m at 10:30 and a further 0.072m at 16:00 on 18 January.  On 20 January at 09:00 the gauge dropped 0.128m.  
2020: Gantry lifted morning 25 January, then lowered and lifted again late afternoon.  Gauge returned to water 12 May; seabed mounting 
had moved horizontally ~1m.
2021: TG0 appears to have been shifted down 0.130m on 17 February at 07:35, down a further 0.148m 19 February at 07:40, then raised 0.305m 
the same day at 14:45 and down 0.190m  25 February at 08:15.  On 16 March TG0 lifted 0.200m at 08:25 then later lowered by 0.072m at 18:25. 
Drift of TG0 commencing 8 February, suggesting that data from then until 17 March should be considered to be unreliable. Gauge re-established 17 Nov.
2023: Data logger changed mid-February; logging rate increased from 5 to 1 minutes
2023: Gauge failed 2 August; reinstalled 25 November
2024: Vertical shift of gauge 10 May 
2025: The RO gantry has been moved landward due to erosion concerns at the old site.
2026: Gauge removed 5 March due to iceberg activity.

===========================================================


FILE NAME FORMAT NOTES
-----------------------

The sea level data .zip file is named using the format
SCOT_yyyyddd.zip, where:

yyyy is the year (eg 2009)
ddd is the day of the year (eg 110, for 20 April).

The .zip file contains a single file of sea level data, 
named in the same format but using a .csv file extension.

===========================================================

SEA LEVEL DATA FORMAT - comma delimited
----------------------------------------

1st field: site code (SCOT)
2nd field: date and time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm) NZST, 24 hour
3rd field: sea level height (metres)

eg:

SCOT,2016-01-05 15:50,1.881
SCOT,2016-01-05 15:55,1.884
SCOT,2016-01-05 16:00,1.888


2024-2025: 

1st field: date (yyyy-mm-dd)
2nd field: time (hh:mm:ss), 24 hour
3rd field: sea level height (millimetres)


eg:

2024-01-01, 00:00:00, 2400
2024-01-01, 00:01:00, 2405
2024-01-01, 00:02:00, 2404

===========================================================
